name: Eduard
intro: I'm co-founder and CTO of [WorkflowTime](https://workflowtime.com). I build AI systems that scale, keep your data safe and keep costs optimal, and I lead the teams building them.
We do research as well, so what we ship is based on what actually works today.

Experience: Co-founder & CTO @ [WorkflowTime](https://workflowtime.com) (50+ case studies, 50K+ hours saved, €1M+ in cost savings)
What we build: AI systems and agents for freight logistics, insolvency law, EU funds, public tenders and venture capital
Mobile apps for beauty commerce, film streaming and a cleaning services marketplace, plus our own consumer apps
Platforms for wholesale (ERP with e-invoicing), sports events (e-commerce and POS), hotels and warehouses
Automation for dental clinics, solar lead routing, payroll and HR, restaurant marketing and news publishing

pillars.detail: Under your control, end to end
